title: patient not visually separable from the person beside them — peds MPFB cast
instrument: the SAME classify regexes as a-station-cast-is-visually-separable.test.ts; palette probe imported automate_blender.garment_shell_color inside Blender; scrub-fit probe ran HumanService.create_human + TargetService.bake_targets + ExportService.bake_modifiers_remove_helpers + ClothesService.fit_clothes_to_human on Scrub_Shirt.obj/.mhclo

factA_paletteFunction.importPath: from automate_blender import garment_shell_color — the SAME lazy pattern the materializer already uses for apply_mesh_native_scalp_hair_material_region (materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py:1606-1608). automate_blender imports only stdlib + bpy at module level; no side effects.
factA_paletteFunction.decision: scrub is LOCKED (0.05, 0.48, 0.52) for every role — the #180b counterweight. closed_casual is the ONLY kind with role divergence (patient olive/cream 0.72,0.68,0.55 vs family neutral 0.42,0.36,0.40). tshirt does NOT diverge by role, so wiring the t-shirt kind alone cannot separate the two patients; the patients' upper+lower must be wired with kind=closed_casual so the function's role fallback does the divergence. The nurse wires kind=scrub (locked colour) + the Scrub_Shirt.mhclo asset. No palette table copied or extended — the function is consumed as-is.

factB_scrubFit.decision: ClothesService accepts Scrub_Shirt.mhclo against the stripped basemesh in a single smoke fit (same call sequence as the toigo t-shirt fit at materialize_mpfb_humanoid_candidate.py:2015-2029). The scrub shirt is CC-BY (WojackOWL, 'Medical Scrubs Kit'), already recorded in third-party-asset-licence-ledger.md with an attribution posture; adding this consumer does not change its licence standing.
